import json,os,resource,time,zipfile
from pathlib import Path
memory={line.split(':')[0]:int(line.split()[1]) for line in Path('/proc/meminfo').read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith(('MemTotal:','MemAvailable:'))}
if memory['MemAvailable']<memory['MemTotal']//5+2*1024**2:raise SystemExit('Insufficient conservative host reserve')
os.sched_setaffinity(0,{min(os.sched_getaffinity(0))});resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(2*1024**3,2*1024**3));resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(20,20))
for key in ('OMP_NUM_THREADS','OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS','MKL_NUM_THREADS','NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS','RAYON_NUM_THREADS'):os.environ[key]='1'
from devtools.reference_validator.model import Model
from devtools.reference_validator.power_cells import _clip
from devtools.reference_validator.power_contracts import PowerLimits,proposed_planes
start=time.perf_counter();cpu=time.process_time()
archive=Path('docs/content/benchlab/synthetic/artifacts/reference_validator_panel_v1/receiving.zip')
with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as stream:raw=stream.read('receiving/cases/straight_tube_wide_sparse/profile_0/model.json')
model=Model.from_record(json.loads(raw));setup={'wall_seconds':time.perf_counter()-start,'cpu_seconds':time.process_time()-cpu}
rows=[]
for index in [0,38,76]:
 atom=model.atoms[index];planes=proposed_planes(model,atom);w,c=time.perf_counter(),time.process_time();support,vertices=_clip(model,planes,PowerLimits())
 rows.append({'atom_id':atom.source_id,'all_planes':len(planes),'support_planes':len(support),'vertices':len(vertices),'wall_seconds':time.perf_counter()-w,'cpu_seconds':time.process_time()-c})
result={'scope':'Three-cell source-clipping preflight on the exact saved original wide 1.4 A Model; not complete topology receiving or a whole-engine runtime.','setup':setup,'n_atoms':len(model.atoms),'domain_planes':len(model.domain.planes),'cells':rows,'elapsed_seconds':time.perf_counter()-start,'cpu_seconds':time.process_time()-cpu,'peak_rss_kib_linux':resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss,'cpu_count':1,'address_space_limit_bytes':2*1024**3,'cpu_limit_seconds':20,'wall_limit_seconds':25}
Path('/tmp/topomt-wide-preflight.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
